reason: Original direct wait4 peak RSS is contaminated by the Python parent's address space before exec; retain it but do not interpret it as target memory.
scope: Same frozen programs, inputs, compiler arguments and three finite scenarios as timing identity freeze-002; memory observations only.
collector: A small C executable first execs into its own small address space, then forks and wait4s the actual target. Report the target's maximum individual-process RSS in KiB, not simultaneous process-tree sum.
order: Each of the original 15 cells in original order, five pairs; ZIL first on even zero-based repetitions, Rust first on odd repetitions.
timing_inference: None. Wrapper elapsed times and direct wrapper wait4 RSS are retained for audit but excluded from all time comparisons and target-memory summaries.
stop_rule: One fixed complete memory series; any failed control or sample invalidates the series; no selection or retries based on observed relative memory.
product_thresholds: Unchanged validation/product-gates.json. Five descriptive memory replicates do not establish full product parity.
